reason: E1 directly states that high configurational entropy stabilizes solid-solution phases and that severe lattice distortion causes low atomic diffusivity, supporting the first two premises. However, E1 discusses bulk HEAs, not nanoparticles, and none of the cited evidence addresses the effect of controlled annealing on local ordering or its role in further suppressing diffusion in nanoparticles, leaving the third and fourth premises unsupported.
premises: High configurational entropy stabilizes solid-solution phases against intermetallics or segregation
Severe lattice distortion in HEAs causes low atomic diffusivity
These effects apply to multi-element near-equiatomic nanoparticles
Controlled annealing can induce local ordering that further pins the structure
